title: You Are It
start: Chop the tree in the south-west of McGrubor's Wood near the quest start marker.

recommended.t: Activated Draynor, Lumbridge, Port Sarim, Seer's Village and Varrock lodestone, or teleport runes

rewards.t: Old necklace, which you can use to find jade trinkets around Gielinor if over level 50 Dungeoneering. Each piece obtained grants 10,000 Dungeoneering experience; if the exact location is known it is possible to obtain these without the Dungeoneering requirement. It is recommended to keep it since it is used in Desperate Times.

steps.t: Teleport to Seers' Village and run north-west to McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring fairy ring | ALS ).
p: The start location of the quest

steps.t: Enter the woods through the Loose railing.
Attempt to chop the tree 14 paces west and 6 paces south of the crate. (Slightly different colour, and near the quest marker on the minimap)
Read the mysterious clue scroll. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace.
Read the mysterious clue scroll again.
Stand in the room with Duke Horacio on the floor 2 of Lumbridge Castle.
p: The dig location in Lumbridge cemetery.
The double agent surrounds the player!

steps.t: Remove all worn items, then perform the Cry and Panic emotes (in that order). You should see a cutscene if it works.

Go to Lumbridge cemetery. Using the mysterious clue's dig option, dig one square to the north of the largest tombstone along the southern fence. You will get a locked casket. You must complete the cutscene in order to continue.
Enter the POH portal in Rimmington to trigger a cutscene.
Teleport to Draynor, run into the Draynor Manor, and head into the first door to the west after entering the building.
Search the bookcase in the north-western part of the room to find the casket key.
Open the locked casket to obtain an old necklace.
Take a rope, and go back into McGrubor's Wood. Enter the railing shortcut and stand two squares south of the crate (which is south of the building).
p: Destroying the Stone of Jas wishmaker.

steps.t: Dig via the old necklace.
Inspect and then descend into the Mysterious Hole.
Follow the path to the end and investigate the coffin for a cutscene.
Talk to the double agent. [Chat: 3 What happens next? › 4 I'm going to look around.]
Investigate the mantle to the east for a cutscene. [Chat: 6 The Stone › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Uri.
Quest complete!
